mapInfo: I supplemented some of the buildings with shared files from the "Building Pool V3." https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2790726238&searchtext=Building+Pool+V3

That being said, I take no responsibility if you fall to your death, or if you get wedged in a crevasse. More to come on this area in the future.
